title: Successful LTE Attach and Detach with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
description: Validate that a single UE can successfully attach and detach to an LTE cell under excellent radio conditions, repeating the procedure 10 times with 100% success rate.
preconditions: Single LTE cell activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with LTE RSRP meeting excellent radio conditions
Test configuration parameters recorded and applied
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach
Wait for detach accept message confirming successful detach
Stop and save the logs
Repeat above attach-detach steps for total 10 iterations
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded for each iteration
UE logs confirm attachment to correct LTE cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Signalling messages validate correct attach and detach procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1
commandsUsed: Generic action: Power ON UE
Generic action: Power OFF UE
Start and stop logging via test system interface
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach success and cell identification
Analyze signalling logs for attach request and attach complete messages
Analyze signalling logs for detach request and detach accept messages
Calculate and record attach latency per iteration

title: Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions

preconditions: Single 5G NSA cell activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with 5G SS-RSRP meeting excellent radio conditions
Test configuration parameters recorded and applied
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach
Wait for attach complete message confirming successful attach
Validate secondary node addition by checking SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach
Wait for detach accept message confirming successful detach
Validate secondary node release by checking SgNB release request and acknowledge messages and RRC connection reconfiguration
Stop and save the logs
Repeat above attach-detach steps for total 10 iterations
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Secondary node addition success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
UE logs confirm attachment to correct LTE and NR cells (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)

Signalling messages validate correct attach, secondary node addition, detach, and secondary node release procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1, 5.3.8.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clauses 10.2.1 and 10.4.1
commandsUsed: Generic action: Power ON UE
Generic action: Power OFF UE
Start and stop logging via test system interface
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach success and cell identification
Analyze signalling logs for attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition, detach request, detach accept and SgNB release messages
Validate RRCConnectionReconfiguration messages indicate SCG release
Calculate and record attach latency per iteration

title: Integration Test of Secondary Node Release Procedure Initiated by Master Node (MN)
description: Verify correct signalling and resource release when MN initiates secondary node release procedure as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
preconditions: 5G NSA cell with MN and SN nodes active
UE attached to 5G NSA cell with secondary node established
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Start logging to capture signalling messages
Trigger MN initiated SgNB Release Request message
Observe SN sending SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message
Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify SN releases UE context and radio/C-plane resources upon UE Context Release message
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: MN initiates release correctly and SN confirms release
UE receives RRCConnectionReconfiguration and releases SCG configuration
SN transfers status and data usage reports correctly
Resources released properly at SN
Procedure aligns with signalling flow in Figure 10.4.1-1
commandsUsed: Generic action: Trigger MN initiated SgNB Release Request
Start and stop logging via test system interface
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling logs for SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages
Verify RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE
Check SN Status Transfer and Data Usage Report messages
Confirm resource release at SN node
